title: Six and seven dimensional extrema of Non-SUSY heterotic theory with non-maximal enhancements
summary: We propose a construction of non-supersymmetric heterotic theories on $T^n$ for $n=1,2,3,4$ that lead to extrema of the one-loop effective potential. In contrast to other approaches, we do not impose maximal gauge enhancement, instead relying on Weyl symmetries of the right-moving part of the momentum lattice to ensure that we get an extremum. The classification depends on finding all lattices within a given genus using Kneser's method. We find several thousand extrema, most of which have non-maximal rank gauge enhancements.
